packageRules.description: One weekly PR for the non-major backend (uv) updates. drf-spectacular is excluded: it can change schema.yml and fail CI until regenerated by hand, so it gets its own PR.
One weekly PR for the non-major frontend (bun) updates. openapi-typescript is excluded: it can change lib/api/generated.ts and fail CI until regenerated by hand, so it gets its own PR.
One weekly PR for the non-major GitHub Actions and Docker image updates (backend/ and frontend/ Dockerfiles included).
The Python runtime moves 3.13 -> 3.14 by hand (.python-version, requires-python, Dockerfile, CI, ruff/ty targets together): Renovate never bumps it.
